<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex008022026-06-2903-47-37" status="unreviewed">
         <milestone n="221111 myi dmyigs pa'i rjes dpag gi gzhal bya bsam pa" unit="section"/>
           <milestone n="A" unit="section"/>
        dang po ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha cig</rs> na re myi dmyigs pa'i rjes dpag gi gzhal bya ni dgag bya'i dngos po yin te | <lb n="108b8"/> <quote n="PV 1.210bc">yod myed phyogs kyi bye brag gis || dngos po nyid ni dpyad bya ste |</quote> zhes gsungs pas gzhal bya la dngos pos khyab la | bsgrub pa'i rjes dpag gzhal bya dngos po ba bsgrub pa'i tshad ma yin pas gzhal bya yod na mi slu la myed na slu ba yin no | 
        
        dgag pa'i rjes dpag ni gzhal bya sel ba'i tshad ma yin pas gzhal bya yod na slu la myed na myi slu ba yin no | 
        myi slu ba yod myed <lb n="108b9"/> dgag bya yod myed la ltos pas dgag bya myi slu ba'i ltos sa yin pas gzhal bya yin no | 
        de lta ma yin na spros pa gcod pa'i rigs pa gzhal bya dang myi ldan na tshad ma myi rung la | kun rdzob kyi bden pa 'jal na tha snyad pa'i tshad mar 'gyur zhing stong nyid don dam pa'i bden pa 'jal na stong nyid de gzhal bya ma yin dgag dang dbyer myed pas ma yin dgag don daM par 'gyur <lb n="109a1"/> ro ; rigs shes nyid kyis stong pa nyid 'jal bar rlom pas rigs shes pa gzhal bya myed pa ma yin la | rang bzhin sems dpa'i blos stong nyid la gzhal bya khegs pas ma yin dgag don dam pa ma yin no zhes kyang 
            rjod par myi nus ste | 
            - rang bzhin sems pa'i blo tshad ma ma yin na des stong pa nyid la gzhal bya yod pa myi khegs la 
            - tshad ma yin na'ang 
               - des stong pa nyid yul <lb n="109a2"/> du ma byas na stong pa nyid la gzhal bya yin pa'i sgro 'dogs gcod myi nus la | 
               - yul du byas na tshad ma tsam gyi yul bkag la rang bzhin sems pa'i tshad ma'i yul du 'dod pas rang gi tshig dang 'gal ba dang | 
               rang bzhin sems pas spros bral la gzhal bya khegs pa na rigs shes la tshad ma yin pa shugs la khegs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro | 
         des na stong nyid gzhal bya ma <lb n="109a3"/> yin yang dgag bya gzhal bas rigs shes gzhal bya dang ldan pa yin no zhes zer ro |</seg></TEI>
